verdict.rationale: Mercury's marketing docs explicitly claim per-card spend limits and granular user permissions (mercury-docs-10, mercury-docs-2), and a first-hand community user confirms creating hundreds of virtual cards with individual limits (mercury-comm-1). However, there is no detailed documentation on the granularity of controls (e.g., merchant category restrictions, time-based limits, approval workflows per employee) beyond high-level marketing copy. missing for 10: detailed docs/API reference on configuring per-card limits and permission granularity, independent verification of how fine-grained controls actually are, and any admin-UI walkthrough.
